messages:
From: Luke Chang <luke.chang@medstream.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — pilot sizing and credits

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — Sara and I found the latency numbers and the routing options really compelling. A couple quick follow-ups from our side so we can finalize our internal ask: 

- Expected volume: we anticipate ~2M inference tokens/day in week 1 of pilot ramp, scaling to ~5M/day by week 4 if performance stays stable (roughly 60M tokens/month at steady state).
- Quality target & model: we want to test the quantized Llama-2-13B variant you recommended to hit our latency SLOs.
- Budget target: we need to stay under ~$450 per 1M tokens on average for inference to make the economics work for our use case.
- Pilot credits: our procurement team asks if you can provide pilot credits to cover initial burn while we evaluate. Ideally a credit topping of $50k would let us run parallel A/B and integration work.
- Timeline: we'd like a 4-week pilot, but can accept a shorter 2-week extension if that's more realistic.

Can you confirm what you can offer on credits and whether Redwood can preserve a dedicated slot for the pilot (or guarantee fallback to a compatible variant)? Also would appreciate any recommended throttles / batching presets to keep unit cost in range.

Thanks,
Luke
Lead Product Manager
MedStream Health

Hi Luke — great conversation yesterday, and appreciate the clear numbers. Recap + proposed next steps below so we have something we can both share with procurement: 

Recap of your ask
- Pilot duration: target 4 weeks (you indicated OK with 2-week fallback)
- Expected burn: ~2M tokens/day ramping to ~5M/day (60M/mo steady)
- Cost goal: ~ $450 / 1M tokens average

What Redwood can offer (proposal)
- Pilot credits: we can offer $25,000 in free credits applied to your account immediately.
- Trial extension: +2 weeks on top of the standard trial window (for a total of pilot-access length we agree).
- Performance: recommend the quantized Llama-2-13B variant with continuous batching + KV caching enabled (should hit your latency SLOs and reduce per-token cost).
- Unit economics guidance: with the model + batching, we expect a realized cost in the $380–$480 / 1M tokens range depending on average sequence length and cache hit rate. Hitting $450 should be achievable with a mix of 1) prompt compression, 2) prefix caching for repeated templates, and 3) our suggested batch size (we'll include sample settings in the attached).
- Capacity: we can reserve a small dedicated slot for the pilot window; if utilization exceeds that, automatic fallback will route to a compatible variant.

Next steps
1) Marissa and Neha from our side to confirm credit approval and send the official credit allocation.
2) Luke / Sara to share a short test prompt set + expected request distribution (tokens per request, ratio of short vs long sessions).
3) We'll provision the pilot environment and share dashboard access + telemetry links.

Attached: pilot_pricing_summary.pdf (pricing bands, recommended batching/config).

If that looks OK I'll ask Marissa to finalize the credit amount.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
